name: Advanced Solid Mechanics
description: Introduction, indicial notations, tensors. Strain and compatibility, stress, and equilibrium. Constitutive modeling, Hooke’s law, viscous fluid. Field equations, boundary conditions, uniqueness of solution, principle of superposition, Saint-Venant’s principle. Plane problems in rectangular and polar coordinates. Energy methods such as reciprocal theorem, virtual work principle and Castigliano’s theorem. Torsion and flexure of elastic members. Application to thick cylinders, rotating discs, curved beams, beams on elastic foundations, torsion of non-circular cross-sections, stress concentration problems, Hertzian contact stresses.
